skill.name: weibo-competitor-research
skill.description: 当用户需要做微博竞品研究、微博竞品分析、同赛道观察、内容角度对比、内容策略对比或品牌内容调研时使用。面向品牌、内容运营和创作者。
skill.summary: Compare Weibo posts from SocialDataX search samples and keep source references for each observation.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access SocialDataX credentials. Most backtick matches are Markdown, and no evidence was found of an embedded secret or an attempt to override the audit. Search results and billing error messages need safeguards before they influence agent actions or payment guidance.

remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed CLI version with verified integrity and require authorization before installation. Run it with a scoped credential and restricted filesystem access.
Use an approved secret store where available and restrict access to the credential. Report only presence and source, never the value or file contents.

remediation.issue: Search results can contain untrusted instructions
remediation.suggestion: Treat post text and links as research data. Do not follow instructions from results or use them to authorize tool calls or disclosure.

remediation.issue: Billing guidance relies on a URL from an error
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed official billing page instead of links from error text. Ask before resuming requests that can consume credits.

content.value_statement: It is hard to compare Weibo competitors without a consistent set of posts. Use SocialDataX search samples to compare content themes and trace observations to source posts.
actual_capabilities: Search Weibo posts by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Limit CLI searches by page count or item count and continue with a returned page token.
Collect post links or IDs, authors, publication times, and visible engagement figures when available.
Compare content themes across returned samples and separate recorded evidence from interpretation.
Report incomplete results and retain the items already collected when a CLI search returns partial data.
limitations: Requires a configured SocialDataX CLI or authenticated MCP connection. Searches may consume service credits.
Search results are samples, not a complete census of Weibo posts or accounts.
Post metadata and engagement figures can be missing or incomplete.
The Weibo workflow does not post, like, comment, or change account settings.

use_cases.title: Compare Launch Messaging
use_cases.description: Review how competing brands describe similar launches and cite example posts for each messaging angle.

use_cases.title: Review Recurring Post Formats
use_cases.description: Compare tutorials, announcements, and promotional posts before planning a Weibo content calendar.

use_cases.title: Find Topics to Test
use_cases.description: Look for questions and angles in a small set of related posts and select topics for further research.

prompt_templates.title: Sample One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Inspect an initial set of posts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Weibo posts for [topic]. Return up to five relevant posts with authors and source links when available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare messaging across equally sized samples.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sample up to 10 Weibo posts per brand for [brand A] and [brand B]. Compare themes and cite a post for each observation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Formats and Engagement
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare content formats using visible source data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 20 Weibo posts about [product category]. Group them by format and report visible engagement without treating it as reach.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Document findings and gaps across multiple queries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Weibo coverage of [launch] across three agreed search terms. Cap each query at 20 posts. Separate observations from hypotheses, cite examples, and label partial results.

output_examples.input: Compare launch messaging for two fictional outdoor brands.
output: Illustrative sample: Four posts per brand.
Brand A emphasizes pack weight. Brand B describes how to fit gear into small spaces.
Follow-up: Compare more posts before deciding whether these themes recur across each brand's launches.

output_examples.input: Review reusable cup posts and flag incomplete coverage.
output: Illustrative sample: Seven posts returned before a request error.
Three posts show cleaning tips and two compare lid designs. Two posts cover other topics.
Coverage is incomplete. These counts describe only the returned posts.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a result limit before expanding.
Keep post links or IDs and distinguish observed details from interpretations.
Use an authorized connector and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating one search sample as a complete account or market analysis.
Comparing engagement without noting missing metrics or differences in publication time.
Retrying a balance error repeatedly or restarting a partial search from page one.

faq.question: What input does the skill need?
faq.answer: Start with a keyword or topic. Add brand names, an audience, or a time period to make the query more specific.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured SocialDataX key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials.

faq.question: Can a search return every relevant post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no guaranteed complete result set, and one empty page does not prove there are no more results.

faq.question: What happens if a search returns partial results?
faq.answer: The skill keeps the returned items and reports the error. It can resume within the original limits when a continuation token is available.

faq.question: Can the skill change a Weibo account?
faq.answer: No. The Weibo search workflow does not sign in to Weibo, publish posts, like posts, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: Can searches cost money?
faq.answer: SocialDataX searches may use service credits. Check your balance and any charges in your account before expanding a search.
